description: Age-specific performances of the existing six rendered Pip layers. Original project choreography; no additional artwork or audio.

shell-rock.label: Shell wiggle
shell-rock.description: A seated duckling tests its balance inside the shell; its heavy head follows a beat late.

sleepy-nuzzle.label: Sleepy nuzzle
sleepy-nuzzle.description: A slow sleepy head tuck, tiny wing cuddle and bright-eyed recovery; shell and feet stay planted.

toddler-wobble.label: Wobbly steps
toddler-wobble.description: Two tentative weight shifts with a small lifted foot and wings spread for balance.

tiny-clap.label: Little claps
tiny-clap.description: An eager two-beat wing clap with a delayed delighted head bob.

curious-peek.label: Curious peek
curious-peek.description: A preschooler leans out, checks the other side and peeks above its visor.

show-and-tell.label: Look what I found
show-and-tell.description: An eager open-wing presentation, then a proud nod toward the player.

rain-boot-stomp.label: Rain-boot steps
rain-boot-stomp.description: Lifts each heavy boot, plants it, and lets the coat and head absorb the landing.

puddle-hop.label: Boots together hop
puddle-hop.description: Crouches inside the raincoat, hops with both boots, then lands feet first.

backpack-ready.label: Ready for school
backpack-ready.description: Tugs both shoulder straps, lifts the backpack with a shoulder shrug, then stands ready.

eager-hand.label: I have an answer
eager-hand.description: Sits into a small anticipation, raises one wing eagerly and leans forward to join in.

warm-up.label: Side stretches
warm-up.description: A controlled athletic reach to each side, counterbalanced by the head and planted sneakers.

balance-challenge.label: One-foot balance
balance-challenge.description: Balances on one sneaker with outstretched wings, corrects a tiny wobble, then deliberately plants the foot.

hoodie-groove.label: Hoodie two-step
hoodie-groove.description: Loose alternating side steps with an independent head counter-beat and low, relaxed wings.

playful-shrug.label: Why not?
playful-shrug.description: Raises both shoulders, tilts the hooded head, then opens one wing in a playful invitation.

think-and-try.label: Think it through
think-and-try.description: Leans in for a closer look through the glasses, pauses to think, then tests an idea with a measured wing reach.

idea-spark.label: An idea!
idea-spark.description: A thoughtful downward glance resolves into a lifted head, one clear raised wing and a satisfied nod.

scout-lookout.label: Scout the horizon
scout-lookout.description: Raises a wing toward the cap, scans deliberately, and points out a direction with an open wing.

confident-step.label: Ready to explore
confident-step.description: A purposeful sneaker step, steady shoulder turn, then a small confident greeting.

rhythm-groove.label: Find the rhythm
rhythm-groove.description: A headphone-inspired restrained groove: head nods lead, shoulders answer, and one sneaker taps.

casual-greeting.label: Easy hello
casual-greeting.description: A relaxed asymmetrical lean, brief wing salute and small nod, with no bouncy whole-body hop.

thoughtful-nod.label: A thoughtful nod
thoughtful-nod.description: Attentive head tilt, a considered pause, then one deliberate reassuring nod; feet and bag stay settled.

welcoming-guide.label: After you
welcoming-guide.description: A composed open-wing invitation, gentle inclination toward the player and unhurried recovery.
